title: Proficience
summary: PROFI'CIENCE PROFI'CIENCY, noun [from Latin proficiens, from proficio, to advance forward; pro and facio, to make.] Advance in the acquisition of any art, science or knowledge; improvement; progressio

inlines.v: PROFI'CIENCE PROFI'CIENCY, noun [from Latin proficiens, from proficio, to advance forward; pro and facio, to make.] Advance in the acquisition of any art, science or knowledge; improvement; progression in knowledge. Students are examined that they may manifest their proficiency in their studies or in knowledge.
